backgrounds.name: Allies
backgrounds.description: Trusted companions at least as powerful as a starting character. Always NPCs who will help but won't risk their lives and expect something in return.

ratings.effect: One ally approximately equal to a starting character
Two allies, or one more powerful ally
Three allies, or fewer more powerful allies
Four allies, or fewer very powerful allies
Five allies, or fewer exceptionally powerful allies

backgrounds.name: Artifact
backgrounds.description: Magical items of power. Can purchase multiple times for different artifacts. Maximum 5 total dots at character creation. 4-5 dot artifacts are rare and coveted.

ratings.effect: Minor artifact
Notable artifact
Significant artifact
Powerful artifact (rare, will attract attention)
Legendary artifact (extremely rare, highly coveted)

backgrounds.name: Backing
backgrounds.description: Rank in an organization (government, army, faction, syndicate). May take multiple times for different organizations. Neglecting duties can result in demotion.

ratings.effect: Lower officer or minor functionary
Mid-level officer or department head
Moderately powerful, many subordinates
Extremely powerful, reports directly to leadership
Leader of organization (general, admiral, Factol, etc.)

backgrounds.name: Contacts
backgrounds.description: People who help in exchange for favors. Each dot provides one major contact and dice for finding minor contacts.

ratings.effect: One major contact, +1 die for minor contacts
Two major contacts, +2 dice for minor contacts
Three major contacts, +3 dice for minor contacts
Four major contacts, +4 dice for minor contacts
Five major contacts, +5 dice for minor contacts

backgrounds.name: Fame
backgrounds.description: Widespread recognition in society. Opens doors but attracts attention.

ratings.effect: Known to a select subculture or city
Nationwide renown (politician, minor star)
Nationally famous, everybody knows something about you
Internationally famous media icon
Famous across crystal spheres

backgrounds.name: Followers
backgrounds.description: Loyal mortal assistants, warriors, or acolytes. Require Wealth, Backing, or Holdings equal to Followers dots to support them.

ratings.effect: Up to 5 followers
20 followers
100 followers
1,000 followers
10,000 followers

backgrounds.name: Holdings
backgrounds.description: Property or spelljamming ship. Requires Followers, Backing, or Wealth equal to Holdings dots for staff/crew.

ratings.effect: Very small spelljammer (shuttle-sized), average house, or small local business
Small spelljammer (smuggling ship), small manor, or successful local business
Medium ship (Bird of Prey-sized), small castle, or large business with off-world contacts
Large ship (Enterprise-sized), huge castle, or multi-world corporation
Massive ship (kilometer-long battleship), massive castle, or megacorporation

backgrounds.name: Inheritance
backgrounds.description: Start play with items beyond normal means. Choose from one tier, or two choices from the tier below.

ratings.effect: One Uncommon, two Common, four Very Common, or eight Ubiquitous items
One Rare item, or two choices from Inheritance 1
One Very Rare item, or two choices from Inheritance 2
One Mythic Rare item, or two choices from Inheritance 3
Any one non-artifact item, or two choices from Inheritance 4

backgrounds.name: Mentor
backgrounds.description: A patron, teacher, and guide. Expects obedience but acts in your best interests.

ratings.effect: Mentor is slightly more worldly and wise than you
Someone of minor note, or important but has little time for you
Wise, influential, and considerably more powerful
Exceedingly important individual whose words shape history
Exceedingly powerful with great interest in your welfare (but expects much and has enemies)

backgrounds.name: Status
backgrounds.description: Reputation and standing within the community of Exalts. Does not cover organizational rank or general fame.

ratings.effect: Known by some Exalts
Respected, words carry weight in discussion
Influential, often asked to consult
Powerful, other Exalts follow your lead
Luminary, few can match your reputation

backgrounds.name: Wealth
backgrounds.description: Personal financial resources and standard of living.

ratings.effect: Middle class, comfortable but little spending money
Comfortable lifestyle, domestic servant, can afford luxuries
Actually wealthy, several servants, life of luxury
Fabulously wealthy (merchant prince, bandit king), can hire armies
Unlimited wealth, no practical limits

notes.cannotImproveWithXP: Backgrounds cannot be improved with XP—only through play.
